overview: The Climate Equity Council met to receive presentations on Medford's affordable housing initiatives and the status of recent environmental and recreation grant applications. Lacking a quorum, the council did not take any formal actions but discussed future meeting logistics and goals.

items.title: Affordable Housing Presentation
items.summary: Housing Planner Katherine Buckingham presented an overview of Medford's affordable housing definitions, inclusionary zoning rules, and the Affordable Housing Trust Fund's action plan and local programs.

items.title: Grants and Projects Update
items.summary: Amanda Centrella provided updates on several regional grant applications, noting that funding was awarded for a community depaving project but denied for the open space plan update and Tufts Park stormwater improvements.

items.title: Future Agenda Setting and Council Discussion
items.summary: The council, lacking a quorum to take formal action, discussed future meeting topics, outreach event dates, and methods to improve communication and track council goals.
